messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed 10x tail-latency for tenant/alpha in eu-west during the 03:10 spike. Looks like router fallback shoved them into shared-gpu-2 when dedicated ran out. Anyone else see this?

infra-bot: Alert: high-gpu-queue-latency tenant=alpha region=eu-west peak_p99=2.1s :rotating_light:

zach: I saw it too. Router spare_capacity_policy='burst' => soft-fallback to shared pools. That saves cost but this is noisy-neighboring hard. We should consider hard isolating tenants with SLA flags.

raj: Agreed. Proposal: prefer dedicated pools by label-weight instead of soft fallback. e.g.
```
routing_weights:
  dedicated: 100
  shared: 20
```
Also add a max_shared_fallback threshold.

julia: Also seeing KV cache thrash on the host when tenant B ramps — mem pressure causes higher fetch latencies. Logs:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep shared-gpu-2
# shared-gpu-2-abcde READY 1/1 10d
kubectl logs shared-gpu-2-abcde | tail -n 50
WARN kvcache: miss rate 0.43, eviction spikes
```

sre-oncall: Short-term mitigation: set router.max_shared_fallback=0 for critical tenants and trigger scale-up of dedicated pool by +2 GPUs in eu-west. I'll push a canary.

zach: Command I will run (canary):
```
kubectl apply -f /srv/configs/router-patch-canary.yaml
curl -X POST 'https://router-internal/reload' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
```
Patch snippet:
```
routing:
  max_shared_fallback: 0.0
  tenant_overrides:
    alpha:
      isolation: strict
``` 

maria: Ran quick test after canary. p99 for alpha dropped from 2.1s -> 350ms. Throughput stable. Cost impact estimate +$2.7k/mo if we keep +2 GPUs dedicated.

raj: That improvement looks solid. Two follow-ups: 1) add alert if fallback > 0.1% so SRE gets paged, 2) autoscale policy to prefer adding dedicated capacity before using shared pool.

julia: I'll open a runbook + billing ticket. We should also add a long-term plan: token-bucket admission and per-tenant KV partitions to reduce cache interference.

maria: Sounds good. Sre-oncall, keep canary running for 2 hours then roll to prod if stable. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deployment: router-patch-canary applied by zach at 1765138525; rollout 10% -> 100% in progress.
